label: geographic neighborhood or area within
definition: Geographic area or neighborhood X is a part of or located within larger geographic place Y.
scope_notes: New geographic-containment meaning supported by the dominant neighborhood/section/area paths. Explicit section, district, neighborhood or area of/in qualifies. Movement between places, organizational ownership and unrelated event location alone do not.

facts.reason: Riverdale is explicitly a section, neighborhood and area of Bronx; movement and street context are mixed.
Williamsburg is explicitly a section, area and neighborhood of/in Brooklyn.
East New York is explicitly a section, area and neighborhood of/in Brooklyn.
Bedford-Stuyvesant is explicitly a Brooklyn section/neighborhood/area/district; school, move and incident context is additional.
Crown Heights is explicitly a Brooklyn section/neighborhood/area; disturbance context is a different proposition.
